experiments.interpretation: The latest real fusion event was sparse enough that perfect targeting could reduce full payload fanout by 55.6%. This is an oracle lower-bound, not evidence that the adaptive candidate would have selected the same four branches.
experiments.blocker: The 15:56 durable record does not itself establish the candidate pre-route BranchDependencyIndex, RoutePlan and FusionReceipt chain, so candidate recall and route-cost error cannot be scored from this event alone.
